Number of organisations on the register of sponsors for study, 2011 to year ending December 2024
1. 'Organisations on the register of sponsors' relates to all organisations that the Home Office recognises as a sponsor for Sponsored study (formerly Tier 4).

2. Data relate to the number of sponsors on the register at the end of the period. Data extracts are taken within a few days of the end of the quarter and may not relate to the actual last day of the quarter.
